action.text: The detect.restored_class criterion requires tests to detect when a subclass is returned instead of the exact InterpolationMissingOptionError. Current code uses assertIsInstance for deep copy and pickle, which accepts subclasses. Fix: change to assertIs(type(...), configparser.InterpolationMissingOptionError) for both. Shallow copy already uses assertIs correctly. File: Lib/test/test_configparser.py, sha c26b26bc...

result.applied_diff:
--- a/Lib/test/test_configparser.py
+++ b/Lib/test/test_configparser.py
@@ -2269,8 +2269,8 @@
 
         # Deep copy preserves all attributes
         e3 = copy.deepcopy(e)
-        self.assertIsInstance(
-            e3, configparser.InterpolationMissingOptionError)
+        self.assertIs(
+            type(e3), configparser.InterpolationMissingOptionError)
         self.assertEqual(e3.args, e.args)
         self.assertEqual(e3.option, e.option)
         self.assertEqual(e3.section, e.section)

criteria.injected_change: Return a subclass after one declared mode/transport while keeping constructor state.
